tools.name: get_quote_estimate
tools.description: Get live mortgage rate estimates for any US location without collecting the borrower's name, email, or phone number. Rates are Safe Rate's non-binding estimates (never quotes; a lender's actual quote may differ), and include an estimate ID the borrower can use to track rate changes.

tools.name: track_quote_estimate
tools.description: Check a previously created Safe Rate rate estimate by its estimate ID. Returns the original scenario, how rates have moved since the estimate was created, and current rates for the same scenario. No account or contact information required.

tools.name: assess_property_context
tools.description: Assess hazard exposure and insurance conditions for a US location: FEMA National Risk Index score, flood-zone coverage and whether flood insurance is likely to be required for a mortgage, wildfire and earthquake exposure, and local insurance-market conditions. Describes the area, not a specific prop

tools.name: get_market_context
tools.description: Get local housing-market context for a US location: median home value with its national percentile, median rent, recent price appreciation, and historical mortgage activity from HMDA filings. Use this to answer whether a price or a market is typical.

tools.name: find_lenders_in_market
tools.description: List the lenders Safe Rate publishes rankings for in a metro area or a whole state, sliced by loan type OR by institution type. Rankings are derived from public federal HMDA filings; placement cannot be purchased. This is a starting list, not a recommendation for a specific borrower.

tools.name: research_lender
tools.description: Look up any US mortgage lender by name or NMLS ID: origination volume, approval and pull-through rates, product mix and geographic footprint, from federal HMDA data.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Safe Rate's published pages: local mortgage-rate indexes by geography, lender profiles, lender rankings by market (optionally by loan type or institution type), and the ranking methodology. Returns document ids for those pages. These are published reference pages, not priced scenarios: they d

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Safe Rate published page by its document id. Returns plain text carrying its own as-of date, canonical URL, data license, and citation notice. Rate index pages are indicative and refreshed daily; they are not a quote for a specific borrower.

tools.name: get_treasury_curve
tools.description: Get the U.S. Treasury yield curve for a single day: the fitted zero-coupon (spot) curve and, on request, the par curve, money-market curve, TIPS real curve, breakeven inflation, the prior trading day for day-over-day moves, and per-CUSIP yields. Omit the date for the most recent published day, which

tools.name: get_treasury_rate_history
tools.description: Get a history of U.S. Treasury yields between two dates: the nominal zero curve, the short-end money-market curve, or the TIPS real curve, one row per trading day. Use this for 'how have rates moved' questions. Coverage starts 2008-09-02. Keep ranges tight — a decade is thousands of rows.

tools.name: get_treasury_security
tools.description: Look up one Treasury security by CUSIP: its terms, price history, and analytics including duration, convexity, DV01 and key-rate durations, plus TIPS and floating-rate analytics where they apply, and the amount outstanding. Takes a CUSIP, not a description such as 'the current 10-year'.

tools.name: list_treasury_securities
tools.description: List Treasury securities as at a date: which security is on-the-run for each tenor (this is how to resolve 'the current 10-year' to a CUSIP), the full outstanding and priced universe, or just the priced CUSIPs. Omit the date for the most recent day with prices.

tools.name: price_treasury_security
tools.description: Convert between price and yield for a Treasury bill, note or bond. Supply exactly one side — a price or a yield (a discount rate for a bill) — and the other is returned, with accrued interest, dirty price and the investment rate as applicable. tools.name: value_savings_bond
tools.description: Value a U.S. Series I or Series EE savings bond: what it is worth now, how it got there, and what the holder would actually receive. Bonds under five years old forfeit three months of interest on redemption, and bonds under twelve months cannot be redeemed at all, so the amount received can be less

tools.name: get_savings_bond_rates
tools.description: Get current and historical U.S. savings bond rates — the Series I composite, its fixed and inflation components, and Series EE rates by issue cohort — and optionally how many bonds the public holds and how many are being sold. An I bond's headline rate applies for six months only; the fixed componen

tools.name: get_treasury_index
tools.description: Get Safe Rate's Treasury total-return indices — by maturity bucket, plus bills, TIPS, floating-rate and aggregate. Call with no code to list every index with its current level and discover the codes. These are TOTAL RETURN levels, not yields: a rising level usually means yields fell. Constructed by

tools.name: get_treasury_debt
tools.description: Get the U.S. federal debt from the monthly Treasury statement: debt held by the public, total public debt outstanding, and its composition, plus the STRIPS float on request. These two headline figures differ by trillions: debt held by the public excludes intragovernmental trust-fund holdings.

tools.name: get_my_application
tools.description: Requires the shopper's Safe Rate sign-in (scope poppy:read). Read the shopper's own Safe Rate Universal Application, the one application they build to share with the lenders they choose (building it is not applying for a loan): their loan scenario (price, down payment, ZIP, occupancy and so on), how

tools.name: get_my_quotes
tools.description: Requires the shopper's Safe Rate sign-in (scope poppy:read). List the quote requests the shopper sent to lenders and the offers that came back (rate, APR, points, product). Offers from Safe Rate Mortgage stay hidden until the shopper accepts the affiliated business disclosure on saferate.com.

tools.name: start_my_application
tools.description: Requires the shopper's Safe Rate sign-in (scope poppy:write). Start building the shopper's Universal Application from a loan scenario. If they already have one, nothing changes and it is returned. Holds no personal information: no name, SSN or date of birth.

tools.name: update_my_application
tools.description: Requires the shopper's Safe Rate sign-in (scope poppy:write). Change answers in the loan scenario of the shopper's Universal Application. Send only the fields that change: everything else keeps its saved value, and nothing is saved if the result would be invalid. Cannot share the application or reco

tools.name: get_share_link
tools.description: Requires the shopper's Safe Rate sign-in (scope poppy:read). Does NOT share anything: sharing an application with a lender always takes the shopper's own click on saferate.com. Returns the link where the shopper reviews and shares it themselves.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_treasury_index" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_estimate, fetch, value_savings_bond, get_savings_bond_rates, get_share_link · Private data: track_quote_estimate, search, fetch, update_my_application · Public sink: get_quote_estimate, get_my_application, update_my_application, get_share_link · Destructive: list_treasury_securities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_estimate, fetch, value_savings_bond, get_savings_bond_rates, get_share_link · Private data: track_quote_estimate, search, fetch, update_my_application · Public sink: get_quote_estimate, get_my_application, update_my_application, get_share_link · Destructive: list_treasury_securities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
